payload.name: Should I Fish?
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Should I Fish answers one question: should you fish a spot today or tomorrow? Ask about a town on the Virginia-to-Florida coast and it returns a Go, Maybe, or Skip verdict with its score, the best bite window for the day and why, high and low tide times from the nearest NOAA tide station, wind, moon phase, sunrise, and any active National Weather Service marine alert, called out first when one is in effect. It's built for recreational inshore and surf anglers, and for anyone at a coastal town wondering whether the morning is worth getting up for, across 136 towns on the Atlantic and Gulf coasts from Virginia through Florida. The plugin answers for today and tomorrow only. It does not forecast further ahead, identify species, say what's biting, or cover water outside Virginia-to-Florida. Tide predictions come from NOAA tide stations and marine alerts from the National Weather Service. The verdict is a model built from tide movement, solunar timing, barometric pressure trend, light, and wind: a guide for planning, not a guarantee of a catch, and not for navigation.

该插件专为休闲近海及冲浪垂钓者设计，也适合所有位于大西洋和墨西哥湾沿岸136个城镇的居民，判断清晨是否值得起床钓鱼。

潮汐预测数据来自NOAA潮汐站，海洋警报信息来自国家气象局。
判断结果基于潮汐运动、潮汐时间、气压趋势、光照和风速构建的模型，仅为规划参考，不保证一定有鱼获，也不用于航行导航。

payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Playlistable is an AI playlist generator for Spotify and Apple Music. Describe a mood, a night, or a job to be done, and it builds a playlist in your own library — not a copy of a list you already have.

In ChatGPT you can:

- Generate a playlist from a mood.
- Search songs or artists on the connected catalog, then save a playlist from the tracks you picked.
- List, open, refine, edit, or delete playlists you already created.

Sign in with Spotify or Apple Music through Playlistable OAuth. Playlists land in Your Library on the connected service. The same product is on the web at https://app.playlistable.io and at https://playlistable.io.

We do not sell a music catalog. We write playlists into the account you connect.
payload.longDescription:
Playlistable是Spotify和Apple Music的AI播放列表生成器。描述一种情绪、一个夜晚或一项任务，它会根据你的个人音乐库创建播放列表——而不是复制你已有的列表。

在ChatGPT中你可以：

· 根据情绪生成播放列表
· 在连接的音乐目录中搜索歌曲或艺术家，然后保存你挑选的曲目播放列表
· 列出、打开、优化、编辑或删除你已创建的播放列表

通过Playlistable OAuth使用Spotify或Apple Music登录。播放列表会保存到连接服务的「我的图书馆」中。同一产品可在网页端https://app.playlistable.io和https://playlistable.io访问。

我们不销售音乐目录。我们把生成的播放列表写入你连接的账户中。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Generate a playlist from a mood for Spotify or Apple Music, Save a playlist from songs you already picked, Search songs and artists on the connected catalog, Refine a playlist with a short instruction, Add or remove specific tracks, List and open playlists in the connected music service

payload.name: GoTickets
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: GoTickets helps users discover live events, compare ticket listings by all-in price, seat quality, section, accessibility, and delivery attributes, read published policies, and continue to checkout through a direct GoTickets URL.
payload.longDescription: GoTickets帮助用户发现现场活动，通过全价、座位质量、区域、无障碍设施和配送属性等维度对比票务列表，查看已发布政策，并通过直接的GoTickets网址继续结账。

payload.name: CCUCheck
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Live player counts and trends for Roblox games, right in ChatGPT. Ask how many people are playing any Roblox game and see its player chart for the last 7 days. Find the most played Roblox games right now, or the top games in a genre like simulator, obby, tycoon or roleplay. Spot established games that are growing fastest this week, and compare up to six games on one chart over 7 to 90 days. Made for Roblox developers researching genres and competitors, and for players curious about what is popular. Every game links to its page on CCUCheck and on Roblox. CCUCheck is independent and not affiliated with Roblox Corporation.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT中实时查看Roblox游戏的玩家数量与趋势。询问任何Roblox游戏的当前玩家数量，并查看其过去7天的玩家数量图表。实时获取当前最热门的Roblox游戏，或查看模拟类、障碍赛、经营类、角色扮演等分类中的热门游戏。发现本周增长最快的传统热门游戏，并可在7至90天周期内将最多六款游戏绘制在同一张趋势图中。本工具专为研究游戏类型与竞品的Roblox开发者，以及想了解热门游戏的玩家设计。每款游戏均链接至CCUCheck平台及Roblox官方页面。CCUCheck为独立平台，与Roblox公司无任何关联。

payload.name: TodoWeekend
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TodoWeekend is an independent guide to things to do on the weekend in Madrid, Barcelona, Lisboa, Paris, Berlin, London, Miami, Santiago de Chile and Tokyo. Ask what is on this weekend, today or tomorrow, or for concerts, exhibitions, theatre, family plans or free events. You get up to 12 curated listings as cards, with the date, venue, price when known, and a link to the TodoWeekend page. Ask for details on any listing to see the full description, address, map point and the seller's own ticket link.

Limits: TodoWeekend covers only the nine cities above. Listings are suitable for ages 13 and up, and nightlife and alcohol-led events are left out. Every answer shows the date the city's data was last updated, and a notice appears when it is more than seven days old, so check the event page before you go. TodoWeekend does not sell tickets and does not need an account. The plugin only reads public listings.
payload.longDescription:
TodoWeekend是马德里、巴塞罗那、里斯本、巴黎、柏林、伦敦、迈阿密、圣地亚哥和东京的周末活动独立指南。询问本周、今天或明天的活动安排，或了解音乐会、展览、戏剧、家庭活动及免费活动信息。您将获得最多12条精选列表卡片，显示日期、场所、已知价格及跳转至TodoWeekend页面的链接。可查看任意列表的详细信息，包含完整描述、地址、地图标记及卖家提供的票务链接。

限制条件：TodoWeekend仅覆盖上述九个城市。所有活动适合13岁及以上人群，不包含夜生活及以酒精为主的活动。每次回答会显示城市数据最后更新日期，若超过七天未更新会特别提示，请出行前查看活动页面。TodoWeekend不销售门票，无需账户即可使用。插件仅读取公开列表。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: List covered cities, Find weekend events, Get event details

payload.name: Cosmic Rebellion
payload.description: 玩一款集换式卡牌游戏
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Cosmic Rebellion is a trading card game in ChatGPT. Pick a starter deck and play a full match against the built-in opponent. The table deals the cards, enforces the rules, and handles every click.

Use it when you want to play. It does not create an account, play cards for you, or decide rules on its own. The table is the source of the rulings.
payload.longDescription:
Cosmic Rebellion 是一款在 ChatGPT 中的集换式卡牌游戏。选择一套起始卡组，与内置对手进行完整对局。游戏桌负责发牌、执行规则并处理每一次点击。

在你想玩的时候使用它。它不会创建账户、替你打牌，也不会自行决定规则。游戏桌是裁定的依据。

payload.name: Cookie Stack with Ottie
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A cozy cookie-merging puzzle against Ottie, right inside ChatGPT. Swipe, use arrow keys, or tap a direction to combine matching cookies. Both trays receive the same cookie drops. The biggest stack wins; merge score breaks a tie. Requires an MCP Apps UI. No Ottie’s World account is required. Temporary game instances expire 20 minutes after creation and reset on server restart. Progress does not transfer to Ottie’s World.
payload.longDescription: 在ChatGPT内进行的与Ottie对抗的饼干合并解谜游戏。滑动、使用方向键或点击方向来合并相同的饼干。两个托盘会收到相同的饼干掉落。最大堆叠量获胜；合并分数可打破平局。需要MCP Apps UI界面。无需Ottie’s World账户。临时游戏实例在创建后20分钟过期，服务器重启后会重置。进度不会同步到Ottie’s World。

payload.name: Art Spotter
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Art Spotter finds original art and prints sold directly by independent artists, and helps artists sell.

One search covers about 21,000 works in 190 independent artists' own shops (checked live for availability) and eBay art, with search links for Saatchi Art, Etsy, Artfinder and Singulart. It also suggests a fair value for new work by size and medium, wall sizing, scam checks, what each selling platform leaves an artist after fees, commission pricing and contract points, open calls and grants in the UK, US and Canada, UK resale royalty maths, and an artwork passport. Nothing about users is stored.
payload.longDescription:
Art Spotter 为独立艺术家直接销售的原创艺术品和印刷品提供发现服务，并帮助艺术家进行销售。

一次搜索可覆盖190位独立艺术家个人店铺（实时检查库存情况）及eBay艺术区的约21,000件作品，提供Saatchi Art、Etsy、Artfinder和Singulart的搜索链接。还提供新作品的尺寸和媒介合理估值、墙面尺寸建议、欺诈检查、各销售平台扣除费用后艺术家实际收益、佣金定价与合同要点、英美加三国的公开征集与资助项目、英国转售版税计算以及艺术品护照功能。不存储任何用户信息。

payload.name: LetterLab Word Solver
payload.description: 单词游戏求解器与乱序单词重组工具
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
LetterLab Word Solver is a word game helper: it unscrambles letters, fills in crossword patterns and narrows down answers in 5-letter guessing games. It looks answers up in a real English dictionary (the ENABLE word list, 172,569 words, with slurs and obscenities removed), so every result is a real word from that list.

Unscramble: type your letters, with ? or * for blank tiles, and see the words you can make, grouped by length with counts and tile points (standard letter values, blanks score 0). Filter by exact length, minimum length, use all letters, starts with, ends with, or contains. Words that use all your tiles are called out.

Crossword and pattern search: type the letters you know and ? for each unknown one (C?T, _A_E_, ??ANGE), or * for any run of letters (S*ING). Add letters that must appear or must not appear. Common words are listed first, then rarer ones.

5-letter guessing games: enter your guesses and the green, yellow and gray feedback (G, Y and - or colored squares). The solver applies the repeated-letter rules, counts and lists the words that still fit, and ranks next guesses by expected information, with the average and worst-case number of words left. Hard mode and 4- to 8-letter variants are supported.

The interactive card shows your letter tiles, word groups with counts you can filter by length, a pattern search, and a tap-to-color guess grid that re-solves as you play.

Limitations: English words from the ENABLE list only (no proper nouns, abbreviations or one-letter words, and some newer words are missing); tile points are face values without board bonuses; it does not define words, solve clues by meaning, or know any game's daily answer.
payload.longDescription:
LetterLab单词求解器是一款单词游戏辅助工具：它可以解乱序字母、填充填字游戏模式，并在5字母猜词游戏中缩小答案范围。该工具通过真实的英文词典（ENABLE单词列表，包含172,569个单词，已去除辱骂和粗俗用语）查询答案，因此所有结果均来自该列表中的合法单词。

解乱序功能：输入你的字母（可用?或*表示空白瓷砖），即可查看能组成的单词，按长度分组显示并附有数量和瓷砖分数（标准字母分值，空白瓷砖得分为0）。可按精确长度、最小长度、必须使用所有字母、起始字母、结尾字母或包含字母进行筛选。使用所有字母组成的单词会特别标注。

填字游戏与模式搜索：输入已知字母并用?表示单个未知字母（如C?T、_A_E_、??ANGE），或用*表示任意字母组合（如S*ING）。可添加必须包含或必须排除的字母。常见单词会优先列出，然后是较生僻的单词。

5字母猜词游戏：输入你的猜测及绿色、黄色和灰色反馈（G、Y和-或彩色方块）。求解器会应用重复字母规则，统计并列出仍符合条件的单词，按预期信息量对下一步猜测进行排序，并显示平均和最坏情况下的剩余单词数量。支持硬模式及4至8字母变体。

交互式卡片显示你的字母瓷砖、可按长度过滤的单词分组、模式搜索功能，以及点击变色的猜测网格，让你在游戏过程中实时重新求解。

限制条件：仅支持ENABLE单词列表中的英文单词（不含专有名词、缩写或单字母单词，部分新单词可能缺失）；瓷砖分数仅计算字母基础分值，不包含棋盘加分；无法定义单词含义、通过语义解答谜题，也不知晓任何游戏的每日答案。

payload.name: Artist Advisory
payload.description: 音乐艺术家的真实数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Artist Advisory shows where a music artist stands, with real numbers instead of guesses.

Name an artist and Artist Advisory shows their career score and tier, their monthly listeners, and their Spotify, TikTok and Instagram followers. Every number shows the day it was checked and how it moved over the last 28 days, so you always know how fresh it is.

Ask how an artist compares and Artist Advisory lines them up against artists at the same level: where they are ahead, where they are behind, and the one gap most worth working on. Ask where a number comes from and it shows the platform, the date it was checked, and how many of the last 28 days it was recorded.

Nothing is estimated. If Artist Advisory hasn't tracked an artist yet, it says so instead of guessing, and points to artistadvisory.io, where a report on that artist can be started.

No account is needed. Artist Advisory only reads numbers it has already collected from public profiles. It does not sign in to any platform, post anything, or change anything. It never receives your conversation: only the artist name or Spotify link you asked about, which is used to find the artist and is not stored.
payload.longDescription:
Artist Advisory 通过真实数据而非猜测，展示音乐艺术家的现状。

输入艺术家名称后，Artist Advisory 会显示其职业评分和层级、月度听众数量，以及 Spotify、TikTok 和 Instagram 粉丝数。每个数据都会显示检查日期以及过去28天的变化情况，让您随时了解数据的新鲜度。

询问艺术家的对比情况时，Artist Advisory 会将他们与同级别艺术家进行对比：显示哪些方面领先、哪些方面落后，以及最值得改进的差距。询问数据来源时，会显示平台、检查日期以及过去28天中记录的天数。

所有数据均为实际记录。如果 Artist Advisory 尚未追踪某位艺术家，会明确说明而非猜测，并指向 artistadvisory.io，您可以在该网站为该艺术家生成报告。

无需账户即可使用。Artist Advisory 仅读取已从公开资料中收集的数字。它不会登录任何平台、发布内容或修改任何内容。它不会保存您的对话记录：仅会使用您询问的艺术家名称或 Spotify 链接来查找艺术家，且该信息不会被存储。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Show an artist's career score, tier and audience numbers, each with the day it was checked, Show how each number moved over the last 28 days, Compare an artist with artists at the same level, with their biggest strength and gap, Show where a number comes from: the platform, the date and how often it was recorded, Say plainly when an artist isn't tracked yet instead of guessing

payload.name: Mythsensus
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Mythsensus runs one birth date through 26 astrology and divination traditions — BaZi, Vedic, Western, Nine Star Ki, Thai astrology and more — and puts the answers side by side. Instead of one voice, you see where the traditions agree and where they openly disagree, with each tradition's own rule shown.

In ChatGPT you can get a Cosmic Score from five core systems, a daily reading, the lore of 1,069 deities across 20+ mythologies, and the actual rules each system uses to calculate.

Mythsensus is for reflection and cultural curiosity, not advice. It gives no lottery numbers and makes no guarantees about outcomes.
payload.longDescription:
Mythsensus将同一出生日期输入26种占星与占卜传统——包括八字、吠陀占星、西方占星、九星气、泰国占星等——并将结果并列展示。您将看到各体系间的共识与分歧，每种体系的规则均以自身方式呈现

在ChatGPT中可获取五大核心系统的宇宙分数、每日运势、20多个神话体系中1069位神祇的神话传说，以及各系统实际使用的计算规则

Mythsensus用于反思与文化探索，不提供具体建议。不提供彩票号码，不对结果作出任何保证

payload.name: Julius: Sports Stats & Fantasy
payload.description: 体育数据和球员统计数据
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Julius is a sports stats and fantasy sports assistant for comparing players, teams and seasons. Explore sports data from uploaded files, saved Julius files or accessible public sources, then create custom rankings, charts and matchup reports.

Player and team comparisons: Analyze game logs, box scores, season totals, per-game averages, head-to-head results and home-away splits. Compare NBA basketball, NFL football, soccer, MLB baseball and NHL hockey statistics when the relevant data is available.

Fantasy football and fantasy basketball: Calculate fantasy points using your league's PPR, half-PPR, standard or custom scoring settings. Compare players, prepare draft cheat sheets and evaluate fantasy roster scenarios. Use supplied or retrievable, dated rankings and projections for trade analysis, start/sit questions, waiver wire research and average draft position (ADP) comparisons.

Sports analytics: Explore shooting efficiency, passing, rushing and receiving production, targets, goals and assists, batting and pitching trends, and other sport-specific metrics. Analyze expected goals (xG), shot locations and advanced statistics when the source includes the required fields.

Create sports charts, player comparison tables, scouting notes and reports. Save your work privately in Julius, continue it later, and publish a saved file when you ask for a public link.

Coverage and freshness depend on your inputs and accessible sources. Results identify the season, date range and assumptions used. Connect your Julius account to get started.
payload.longDescription:
Julius是一款体育数据和幻想体育助手，用于比较球员、球队和赛季。通过上传文件、保存的Julius文件或可访问的公开来源探索体育数据，然后创建自定义排名、图表和对阵报告。

球员和球队比较：分析比赛记录、技术统计、赛季总数据、场均数据、交锋记录和主客场分差。当相关数据可用时，可比较NBA篮球、NFL橄榄球、足球、MLB棒球和NHL冰球统计数据。

幻想足球和幻想篮球：根据联盟的PPR、半PPR、标准或自定义计分规则计算幻想分数。比较球员、准备选秀速查表并评估幻想阵容情景。使用提供的或可获取的日期相关排名和预测进行交易分析、首发/替补决策、自由市场研究和平均选秀顺位（ADP）对比。

体育分析：探索投篮效率、传球、跑球和接球产量、目标、进球和助攻、击球和投球趋势以及其他运动特定指标。当数据源包含必要字段时，分析预期进球（xG）、射门位置和高级统计数据。

创建体育图表、球员比较表格、球探笔记和报告。在Julius中私密保存工作内容，稍后继续编辑，并在需要时通过公共链接发布保存的文件。

覆盖范围和数据新鲜度取决于您的输入和可访问的数据源。结果会标明使用的赛季、日期范围和假设条件。连接您的Julius账户即可开始使用。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Compare player and team statistics, Analyze game logs, Calculate fantasy points, Evaluate fantasy roster scenarios, Create sports charts and reports, Save sports files, Publish sports reports

payload.name: PartyCam

PartyCam emails you a link to save the album to your phone, see the photos as they arrive and download them after the event.

payload.name: Maybelline Virtual Try On

payload.longDescription:
直接在ChatGPT内体验纽约蜜丝佛陀美妆虚拟试妆。探索色号与妆效，实时试用精选产品，并查找线上或附近的购买渠道。

payload.name: Kidoo
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Kidoo creates personalized, illustrated children's books where the child is the hero. Ask about themes, art styles, prices in your currency and how the book is delivered, get ideas for birthday gifts and party favors, and start a book here that you finish on the Kidoo site. Photos of the child are only ever uploaded on the Kidoo site, never in the chat. Payment also happens on the Kidoo site.

Dun Dun Dungeon是一款叙事性地牢探索游戏。
创建一个持久角色，在自由对话中描述其行动，并通过服务器处理的房间进行游戏。

payload.name: Partynado
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Discover public parties in Switzerland and Germany. Browse event cards, see local dates, venues and admission prices, and open details on Partynado. Refine location, date, music or budget in chat. Unknown prices are shown explicitly. No account or purchase is required.
payload.longDescription:
在瑞士和德国发现公共派对
浏览活动卡片，查看本地日期、场地和入场价格，并在Partynado上查看详细信息
在聊天中细化地点、日期、音乐或预算
未知价格会明确显示
无需账户或购买

payload.name: SeatCommons
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Search upcoming concerts, sports, theater and comedy on SeatCommons. Read event dates and venues, compare seats by quantity, section and budget, and get a link to complete checkout on SeatCommons. No SeatCommons account is needed to browse. All four tools are read-only: no holds, orders or payments. Prices include processing and exclude sales tax. Prices match the standard SeatCommons website price. A lower first-order price, when available, is shown separately and applies only to a buyer's first SeatCommons order. Checkout verifies eligibility and the final fee. Buying requires sign-in, phone verification, review of terms and authorized payment. Checkout is US-only. Availability can change; some links open an event date and require seat selection again.
payload.longDescription: 在SeatCommons上搜索即将举行的音乐会、体育赛事、戏剧和喜剧表演。查看活动日期和场地，根据数量、区域和预算比较座位，并获取前往SeatCommons完成结账的链接。浏览无需SeatCommons账户。所有四个工具均为只读模式：不支持预留、订单或支付。价格包含处理费，不含销售税。价格与SeatCommons官网价格一致。当有优惠时，较低的首单价格会单独显示，且仅适用于买家的首个SeatCommons订单。结账时会验证资格及最终费用。购买需登录、手机验证、阅读条款并完成授权支付。结账功能仅限美国地区。库存可能随时变动；部分链接打开后需重新选择座位。

payload.name: Statz Football
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Look up football (soccer) statistics and Statz model projections in ChatGPT.

What you can do:
- See the top 10 teams and players the Statz model projects for matches in the next 7 days: win probability, both teams to score, clean sheets, team goals, shots, corners, cards, player goals, assists and more.
- Check season stat leaders in a competition: top scorers, assists, shots, tackles, and team goals, shots and corners.
- Find players on active streaks, such as a shot on target in every recent game.
- Compare both teams' season leaders for an upcoming match.
- List upcoming fixtures with the model's win, draw and loss probabilities.

Answers come with a ranked board and links to the full stats on statz.ai. Open Statz from the sidebar to browse the boards by competition, or mention a team, player or competition in the ChatGPT desktop app.

Statz covers the Premier League, Europe's top leagues, lower English divisions and international football. It provides statistics and projections only: no odds and no betting services.
payload.longDescription:
在ChatGPT中查看足球（ soccer）统计数据和Statz模型预测。

您可以：
- 查看Statz模型预测的未来7天比赛的前10名球队和球员：胜率、两队均进球、零封、球队进球、射门、角球、黄牌、球员进球、助攻等
- 查看联赛赛季统计领袖：最佳射手、助攻、射门、抢断以及球队进球、射门和角球数据
- 查找处于火热状态的球员，例如连续每场均有射正表现
- 对比即将进行比赛的两队赛季领袖数据
- 查看模型预测的胜负平概率的赛程安排

回答会附带排名榜单和跳转至statz.ai的完整数据链接。
点击侧边栏打开Statz，可按联赛浏览榜单，或在ChatGPT桌面应用中提及球队、球员或联赛名称。

Statz覆盖英超联赛、欧洲顶级联赛、英格兰低级别联赛和国际足球赛事。
仅提供统计数据和预测功能：不涉及赔率和投注服务。

payload.name: Airline Executive
payload.description: 航空高管游戏分析与信息

Ask about game mechanics such as offline catch-up, simulation time, airports, aircraft, research and route feasibility without signing in. 《航空高管》的只读辅助工具，这是一款航空管理游戏。
无需登录即可询问游戏机制相关问题，例如离线追赶上、模拟时间、机场、飞机、研究和航线可行性。

Find the official public player, programme and artist information, and the Listener Center for private studio contact. Audio plays on the station website. Live schedules and now-playing information are reported only when verified from the current public source.
payload.longDescription: 由Pinnacle Nexus LLC运营的Pinnacle Nexus Radio听众指南。查找官方公开播放器、节目及艺术家信息，以及用于私人工作室联系的听众中心。音频在电台网站播放。直播时间表和当前播放信息仅在从当前公开来源验证后才会发布。

payload.name: thott.bot
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
thott.bot makes ChatGPT an expert on World of Warcraft: Forever. Ask about anything you'd normally look up, in your own words: a talent, an item, a quest, a build, what the latest patch changed. The answer comes from Blizzard's own game files for the build you're playing.

- From the source. Game facts come from the current Forever game files, and news and developer statements come straight from Blizzard. When they don't cover something, thott.bot says so instead of guessing.
- Kept current. New builds and hotfixes are added automatically, usually within minutes of Blizzard shipping them.
- It knows what changed: between any two builds or hotfixes, and everything Forever changed from Classic.
- It has the rest of what you look up: Blizzard's posts, news and dev notes, plus community data such as popular talent builds from Talents Forever, credited and linked.
- It draws the answer: talent trees you can click, the game's own tooltips and what changed, right in the chat.
- For addon developers: the Forever client's addon API, its combat restrictions and code examples.

For anyone playing WoW Forever, from first-time players to theorycrafters and addon developers.

Limitations: thott.bot covers World of Warcraft: Forever only, not retail WoW or other Classic versions. It doesn't yet hold boss strategy, class guides, stat priorities, auction house prices or complete loot tables, and we're adding more all the time. Connecting needs a thott.bot account (sign in with Discord, Google or email).

thott.bot is not affiliated with or endorsed by Blizzard Entertainment, Wowhead, ZAM or the original Thottbot.
payload.longDescription:
thott.bot让ChatGPT成为《魔兽世界：永恒》的专家。
用你自己的话询问任何你通常会查找的内容：一个天赋、一件物品、一个任务、一个配装方案，或者最新补丁的改动内容。
答案来源于你所游玩版本的暴雪游戏文件。

- 来自原始资料。
游戏数据来源于当前永恒版本的游戏文件，新闻和开发声明直接来自暴雪。
当内容未被覆盖时，thott.bot会明确说明而非猜测。
- 数据持续更新。
新版本和热修复会通常在暴雪发布后几分钟内自动添加。
- 清晰展示改动内容：可在任意两个版本或热修复之间，以及永恒版本对经典旧世的所有改动。
- 提供完整参考资料：暴雪的官方帖子、新闻和开发日志，以及社区数据如Talents Forever上的热门天赋配装方案（已标注来源链接）。
- 可交互查询结果：包含可点击的天赋树、游戏内工具提示及改动说明，直接在聊天窗口展示。
- 为插件开发者提供支持：永恒客户端的插件API、战斗限制及代码示例。

适用于所有《魔兽世界：永恒》玩家，从新手到理论玩家及插件开发者。

限制说明：thott.bot仅覆盖《魔兽世界：永恒》版本，不包含零售版魔兽或其它经典版本。
目前暂不支持Boss攻略、职业指南、属性优先级、拍卖行价格或完整装备掉落表，我们正在持续补充中。
需要注册thott.bot账户进行连接（支持通过Discord、谷歌或邮箱登录）。

thott.bot与暴雪娱乐、Wowhead、ZAM或原版Thottbot无任何关联。

information.value: Search WoW Forever knowledge, Read full game details, See what changed between builds, Draw talent trees and tooltips

payload.name: Screenwise

Screenwise rates movies, shows, books, video games, apps, podcasts and board games with WISE scores: Wholesome, Imaginative, Safe and Enriching, 0 to 100 each, with the age it fits and what to watch for. Ask for picks for your kids' ages and interests and see them as cards with the scores and a note on why each one fits. Ask a parenting question about screens, games or phones and get the answer from 14,000+ Screenwise guides, with a link to the full guide.
payload.longDescription: 为您的家庭找到最适合观看、游玩和阅读的内容，根据孩子的特点提供个性化推荐。Screenwise通过WISE评分体系对电影、剧集、书籍、电子游戏、应用、播客和桌游进行评分：有益、富有想象力、安全和有益的评分，每项0至100分，并标注适合的年龄及观看要点。根据孩子的年龄和兴趣提出推荐，以卡片形式展示各项评分及推荐理由。关于屏幕、游戏或手机的育儿问题，可从14,000多篇Screenwise指南中获得解答，并附带完整指南链接。

payload.name: TIX
payload.description: 澳大利亚和新西兰的现场演出
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
TIX helps you find live shows on sale in Australia and New Zealand: theatre, musicals, concerts, comedy, opera, dance, family shows and experiences.

Ask what's on in a city tonight, this weekend or over the next month, or search by show, category or venue. Each result lists the show's dates, cities and ticket options, including Lasttix last-minute tickets where they're available. You can see a show's ticket options by venue and date, and view results as cards with images.

Tickets are bought on the official ticket seller's site: each result links to the show's page on tix.com.au, which has session times and the Buy now link. If someone asks to hear about a show later, TIX gives them a link to the alert sign-up on that show's page, where they enter their own details.

Limits: TIX lists shows currently on sale on tix.com.au only. Some prices are only shown on the TIX website. Session times and seat availability are on the ticket seller's site.
payload.longDescription:
TIX帮助您查找澳大利亚和新西兰正在销售的现场演出：剧院演出、音乐剧、音乐会、喜剧、歌剧、舞蹈、家庭演出及体验活动。

您可以查询某座城市今晚、本周末或未来一个月的演出安排，或通过演出名称、类别或场地进行搜索。每个搜索结果会列出演出的日期、城市和票务选项，包括可提供的Lasttix临时候选票。您可按场地和日期查看演出的票务选项，并以带图片的卡片形式查看结果。

票务需在官方售票网站购买：每个搜索结果都会链接至tix.com.au上的演出页面，该页面包含场次时间及「立即购买」链接。如果有人希望之后了解某场演出信息，TIX会提供该演出页面的警报注册链接，用户可输入自己的联系方式。

限制条件：TIX仅列出tix.com.au网站当前正在销售的演出。部分价格仅在TIX网站显示，场次时间和座位情况请以售票网站信息为准。

- 通过标题查找单曲，也可限定特定艺术家

payload.name: BingeTube
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
BingeTube helps you find short drama series to watch. Short dramas are vertical series told in 1–2 minute episodes: billionaire romance, revenge, mafia, werewolf and fantasy, hidden identities and more.

Ask in your own words and BingeTube can:
- Search its catalog of 2,000+ series by title or by words from the story
- Recommend series for a mood, trope or story you like, such as "revenge after divorce" or "werewolf romance"
- Tell you about one series: what it's about, its genres and how many episodes it has
- Show what viewers are watching most right now, overall or for one genre

Every answer links straight to the series on binge.tube, so you can start watching in any web browser, with no app to install.

The app only reads BingeTube's public catalog. It needs no sign-in and doesn't change anything.
payload.longDescription:
BingeTube帮你找到可以观看的短剧系列。
短剧是以1-2分钟每集的竖屏系列形式呈现：包含亿万富翁爱情、复仇、黑手党、狼人和奇幻、身份隐藏等多种类型。

用你自己的话提问，BingeTube可以：

- 根据你的心情、套路或喜欢的剧情推荐剧集，例如「离婚后复仇」或「狼人爱情」

payload.name: GolfCore

Golfers whose GolfCore account includes on-course features can sign in for distance to the flag and AI caddie advice from their position in the GolfCore app; for other accounts those features are unavailable. Club bookings, personal score updates, events, member rosters and messaging stay in the GolfCore app.
payload.longDescription: 通过名称或位置查找高尔夫球场，查看GolfCore已映射的球场，查阅包含球场评分和坡度的发球台特定记分卡，并在GolfCore应用中打开球场地图。球场搜索无需GolfCore账户。拥有球场功能的GolfCore账户用户可登录以获取从当前位置到旗杆的距离及AI球童建议；其他账户则无法使用这些功能。俱乐部预订、个人分数更新、活动、会员名单和消息功能均保留在GolfCore应用中。

payload.name: FootVal
payload.description: 球员估值、统计数据与实时比分
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
FootVal brings independent football player valuations, statistics and live scores into ChatGPT.

Ask what a footballer is worth and get FootVal's estimated transfer value next to the market value, with the factors that explain the gap: performance, age and potential, contract, durability, reputation and form. Compare up to four players side by side, scout by league, club, nation, position, age, preferred foot and value, and list the most valuable, most undervalued and most overvalued players, the biggest risers and the best young talents.

FootVal also covers live football: scores and fixtures, match centres with events, team statistics and line-ups, league tables, a team's next and recent matches, season leaderboards for goals and assists, and the latest transfer news and rumours. Results appear as interactive cards you can tap through to a player, club, league or match.

Who it is for: football fans, fantasy managers, writers and anyone curious about what players are worth.

Good to know: FootVal's values are model estimates, not offers or financial advice. Player valuations cover the European top divisions plus MLS and the Saudi Pro League; live data covers the competitions FootVal follows. FootVal is read-only: it never posts, buys or changes anything. Connecting requires signing in to FootVal.
payload.longDescription:
FootVal将独立的足球球员估值、统计数据和实时比分整合至ChatGPT中。

询问某位球员的估值即可看到FootVal的转会估值与市场价并列显示，同时呈现影响差价的要素：表现、年龄与潜力、合同状况、稳定性、声誉和竞技状态。
可同时对比最多四位球员，按联赛、俱乐部、国家队、位置、年龄、惯用脚和估值进行球探分析，列出最值、最被低估和最被高估的球员，以及最大涨幅和最佳新星。

FootVal还提供实时足球数据：比分赛程、包含赛事事件的赛事中心、球队数据与阵容、联赛积分榜、球队近期与下场赛事、进球和助攻赛季排行榜，以及最新转会新闻和传闻。
结果以可点击的交互卡片形式呈现，可跳转至球员、俱乐部、联赛或赛事页面。

适用对象：足球迷、幻想经理、撰稿人以及对球员价值好奇的用户。

重要说明：FootVal的估值为模型估算值，非实际报价或财务建议。
球员估值覆盖欧洲顶级联赛及MLS、沙特职业联赛；实时数据仅涵盖FootVal关注的赛事。
FootVal为只读模式：不会发布、购买或修改任何内容。
连接需登录FootVal账户。

payload.name: Kickwise
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Kickwise publishes an AI model's predictions for football (soccer) matches, made before kickoff, and grades every call in public.

Ask for today's or tomorrow's matches, or one league over the coming days (Premier League, Champions League, La Liga, Ligue 1, Serie A, Bundesliga, Saudi Pro League, Egyptian Premier League, Botola Pro, Liga MX, Brasileirão and MLS). Each match comes with the chance of a home win, a draw and an away win, the AI's pick, the kickoff time and a link to its kickwise.ai page with lineups, the live score and where to watch.

About an hour before kickoff, once the confirmed lineups are out, the AI also predicts the exact final score. Ask for a match summary and Kickwise gives the AI's preview before kickoff, a live reading during the match or a recap after it, written from recent form, the confirmed lineups and injuries, formations, statistics and key moments, together with both starting lineups and formations. Once a match is over, Kickwise says whether the pick and the exact score were right.

What makes Kickwise different is that every call is made before kickoff, time stamped and graded in public at kickwise.ai/ai/record, misses included. As of 21 October 2026, its confident picks (the AI gave its pick 65% or more) were right 84% of the time over the last 90 days (54 of 64), against 63% for always picking the home team on the same matches; across every call in the last 30 days it was right 65% of the time (82 of 126).

No account needed: the tools receive only the team, league, day and language a question needs, never your conversation or anything about you, as the privacy policy at kickwise.ai/privacy sets out. Team names and links in English, Spanish, French, Arabic or Portuguese. 将你的Mana Vault账户连接起来，查找已拥有的《魔法：收集者之战》卡片，查看数量和牌组，搜索公共卡片目录，并进行所需的收藏或牌组调整。
你需要一个Mana Vault账户。

payload.name: Kaucim Palm Reading
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Upload a clear palm photo for English observations and suggested positions of the life, head, and heart lines. Inspect suggestions on your photo, adjust points, or trace a visible line yourself. Unclear lines may be left blank. Explore the illustrated guide without uploading. Palmistry is offered for reflection and entertainment. The app does not determine health, lifespan, or future events.
payload.longDescription:
上传清晰的掌纹照片，获取英文观察结果及生命线、智慧线和感情线的建议位置。
在照片上查看建议，调整标记点，或自行描画可见线条。
模糊线条可留空。

手相学仅用于反思和娱乐。
本应用不用于判断健康状况、寿命或未来事件。

payload.name: Kallax.io
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A read-only Kallax.io integration for board game enthusiasts, cafés, gaming groups, collectors, and organizers. Search the public board-game catalogue and public collections, including wishlists, and discover public board-game events and local communities such as cafés, clubs, stores, and groups. Results link back to Kallax.io. No sign-in is required for the connected MCP server, and the plugin does not create, edit, purchase, or otherwise modify anything.
payload.longDescription: 专为桌游爱好者、咖啡馆、游戏团体、收藏者和组织者设计的只读型 Kallax.io 插件。搜索公开的桌游目录和公开收藏（包括心愿单），并发现公开的桌游活动及本地社区，如咖啡馆、俱乐部、店铺和团体。搜索结果将链接回 Kallax.io。连接的 MCP 服务器无需登录，且该插件不会创建、编辑、购买或以其他方式修改任何内容。

payload.name: Pairloop Doubles Mixer
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Plan a social doubles schedule with rotating partners for a pickleball mixer, tennis mixer schedule, padel americano or badminton session. Enter 4 to 48 individual player names, courts and rounds, then get a seeded rotation with balanced sit-outs and a partner and opponent fairness summary.

Browse courts by round, enter game scores, and calculate individual wins, losses, draws, points for, points against, point difference and win percent with a stated tie-break order. Download a Letter or A4 PDF with score boxes, a CSV schedule and portable schedule JSON. Optional group A and group B labels make cross-group partners without asking for gender.

For social play. No rating or skill balancing. Does not apply tournament governing rules or make fixed-team brackets. General search is bounded and may leave partner repeats above the reported counting lower bound. Unequal groups can be refused when balanced sit-outs are impossible. Digital names are preserved; printed names use Latin characters and player numbers. Download links include schedule settings; share with intended participants.
payload.longDescription:
通过轮换搭档规划乒乓球混合赛、网球混合赛、美式帕德尔球或羽毛球赛的社交双打赛程。
输入4到48名选手姓名、球场和轮次，即可获得带种子轮换的平衡轮休方案，并生成搭档和对手公平性摘要。

按轮次浏览球场，输入比赛得分，根据既定的平分规则计算个人胜负、平局、得分、失分、净胜分及胜率。
下载带计分框的A4/A5 PDF、CSV赛程表和可移植的JSON赛程文件。
可选的A组/B组标签可实现跨组搭档配对，无需输入性别信息。

适用于社交性娱乐比赛。
不涉及评级或技能平衡。
不适用赛事管理规则或固定队伍赛制。
通用搜索范围有限，可能无法完全避免搭档重复次数低于报告下限的情况。
当无法实现平衡轮休时，不等量分组可能被系统拒绝。
数字名称会保留原样；打印名称使用拉丁字母和选手编号。
下载链接包含赛程设置；可分享给指定参与者。

payload.name: Tableu
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Tableu draws and interprets tarot readings for six structured spreads, returns generated narratives, and can save readings or user reflections to the linked account's journal when explicitly requested.
payload.longDescription: Tableu为六种结构化牌阵抽取并解释塔罗牌占卜，提供生成的叙事内容，并可在用户明确请求时将占卜结果或用户反思保存至关联账户的日记中。

payload.name: VedPatrika
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Explore your Vedic birth chart through traditional Jyotish calculations. VedPatrika calculates Lagna, Moon sign, nakshatra, planetary signs and houses, current Vimshottari dasha, and selected yogas. It also checks traditional Mangal Dosh combinations and cancellations, current Sade Sati or Dhaiya, and selected Pitra Dosh combinations.

Provide your date of birth, exact local birth time, and birthplace city with its country. Supported cities worldwide use the relevant time zone. If a place is ambiguous, you will be asked to clarify it. Some villages and smaller places may not be available; birthplace precision matters.

Responses can be explained in Hindi, Hinglish, or English. Astrology is paramparik maargdarshan: a traditional framework for reflection, with interpretations that may differ between traditions. It does not guarantee events or outcomes and should not decide medical, legal, financial, or relationship choices. A dosh or transit label is a traditional chart classification, not proof that harm will occur.

The app is limited to these calculations. It does not create orders, process payments, or deliver reports. It requires no account login. Only the birth details needed for the requested calculation should be shared.

birth_place is the person's birthplace for the chart, not their current location; we never request GPS, address or current city.
payload.longDescription:
通过传统Jyotish计算探索您的吠陀出生星盘。VedPatrika会计算升点、月亮星座、纳克什特拉、行星星座和宫位、当前维姆绍特里分段时间，以及选定的星象组合。它还会检查传统的火星障组合及其化解方式、当前萨德萨蒂或达伊亚周期，以及选定的祖先障组合。

请提供出生日期、精确的本地出生时间以及出生城市和所属国家。全球支持的城市会自动使用当地时区。如果地点存在歧义，系统会要求您进一步确认。部分村庄或小型地点可能无法查询；出生地的精确性至关重要。

回应可使用印地语、印式英语或英语进行解释。占星术属于传统反思框架，不同流派的解读可能有所差异。它无法保证具体事件或结果，不应作为医疗、法律、财务或人际关系决策的依据。所谓的障或星体运行标签仅为传统星盘分类，并非表明伤害必然发生。

该应用仅限于上述计算功能。它不会创建订单、处理支付或生成报告。无需账户登录即可使用。仅需提供与当前计算相关的出生信息。

出生地是指用于绘制星盘的出生地点，而非当前所在位置；我们绝不会请求获取GPS定位、地址或当前城市信息。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Vedic birth chart basics, Mangal Dosh combinations, Sade Sati and Dhaiya, Pitra Dosh combinations

payload.name: Gamechalk Score Keeper
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
For game-night entertainment, Gamechalk Score Keeper offers a live scoreboard, five-dice score sheet scoring, and a 301 or 501 darts scorer. Open a board for 2–12 players with highest-score, lowest-score, or first-to-target modes; adjust points with plus/minus controls, view the leader, and use history and undo for the last 20 actions. Change the scoring step with the Smaller step and Bigger step buttons.

Score thirteen dice categories, the 35-point upper bonus at 63 or more, and eligible 100-point repeat five-of-a-kind bonuses. Provide play_order for the roll chronology; when omitted, the tool assumes the listed category order from ones through chance. A full house requires a distinct triple and pair; eligible repeats use joker scoring when the matching upper category is filled.

Darts input uses S1–S20, D1–D20, T1–T20, SB, DB, or 0 for a miss. The result includes turn scores, busts, remaining points, a three-dart average, and a computed shortest checkout under the chosen out rule. Dice sheets and darts legs include CSV downloads. Scores stay in the open widget only. No online multiplayer; darts starts are limited to 301 and 501.
payload.longDescription:
为游戏之夜提供实时计分板、五颗骰子计分表以及301或501飞镖计分器。开启支持2至12名玩家的游戏板，可选择最高分、最低分或先达目标模式；通过加减控制调整分数，查看排行榜，并可使用历史记录和撤销功能回退最近20次操作。通过更小步长和更大步长按钮调整计分步长。

计算十三种骰子类别分数，63分及以上时获得35分上半部分奖金，符合条件的五同组合可获得100分重复奖励。提供游戏顺序以记录投掷顺序；若未指定，工具将默认使用从一二三到机会的类别顺序。葫芦牌型需包含独立三张相同牌和一对，符合条件的重复组合在对应上半部分类别已填满时启用王牌计分法。

飞镖输入支持S1–S20、D1–D20、T1–T20、SB、DB或0表示未命中。结果包含回合得分、爆分记录、剩余分数、三镖平均分以及根据选择的出局规则计算的最短清分路径。骰子表格和飞镖局数据支持CSV下载。分数仅保存在打开的窗口中。不支持在线多人模式；飞镖开局仅限301和501模式。

payload.name: Birth Oracle
payload.description: 八字与紫微斗数命盘解读
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Birth Oracle combines deterministic BaZi and Zi Wei Dou Shu chart calculations with conversational interpretation. Explore your natal chart, notable chart patterns, timing and forecasts, compare insights across the two systems, and inspect the reasoning behind a reading.
payload.longDescription: Birth Oracle 将命定的八字与紫微斗数命盘计算与对话式解读相结合。探索您的出生盘、重要命盘模式、时间与预测，对比两种系统的洞察，并查看解读背后的逻辑。

payload.name: LexiDaily
payload.summaryOriginal: A daily word puzzle in chat
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: A new five-letter word every day. You have six tries: purple tiles are the right letter in the right spot, orange ones are in the word but somewhere else. Type on the board or just tell ChatGPT your guess. Stuck? Ask for a hint and ChatGPT gives you a cryptic nudge without spoiling the word. Keep your streak alive, then dig into the word's story once you've solved it.
payload.longDescription: 每天一个五个字母的单词。你有六次机会：紫色方块表示正确字母且位置正确，橙色方块表示该字母存在于单词中但位置不对。在棋盘上输入或直接告诉ChatGPT你的猜测。卡住了？请求提示，ChatGPT会给你神秘的提示但不会泄露答案。保持连续答题，解开谜题后还能深入了解该单词的故事。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Daily five-letter word puzzle, Guess on the board or in the chat, Spoiler-free hints from ChatGPT, Streaks and stats

payload.name: Astro Yuvam
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Astro Yuvam calculates astrology and numerology data with the same engine as the tools on astroyuvam.com (Swiss Ephemeris, historical time-zone and daylight-saving rules). Ask for a birth chart and get the Sun, Moon, rising sign, all planets with houses, 12 house cusps and aspects on an interactive chart wheel, with Placidus, Koch, Equal or Whole Sign houses. See where the planets are right now and which ones are retrograde. Ask the Sky answers one specific question with traditional horary astrology: a chart is cast for the moment you ask, and you get a yes, no or not-clear-yet verdict with its strength, the expected timing when the chart shows one, and the main reasons. It does not answer questions about health, pregnancy or death. You can also calculate Life Path and name numbers, and check whether daylight saving time applied on a birth date. Works in Turkish, English, German, Spanish, French, Portuguese, Italian and Russian. No sign-in needed.
payload.longDescription:
Astro Yuvam 使用与astroyuvam.com相同的引擎（瑞士星历表、历史时区和夏令时规则）计算占星术和数术数据。
请求出生星盘，获取太阳、月亮、上升星座、所有行星的宫位、12宫宫头以及交互式星盘轮上的相位信息，支持普拉西德斯宫、科赫宫、等宫或全宫制。
查看当前行星位置及哪些行星处于逆行状态。
「问天」通过传统占星术回答一个具体问题：在您提问的瞬间生成星盘，您将获得明确的「是」「否」或「尚不明确」的结论，并附带结论强度、星盘显示结果的预期时间以及主要原因。
此功能不回答有关健康、怀孕或死亡的问题。
您还可以计算生命路径数和名字数，并核查出生日期是否适用夏令时。
支持土耳其语、英语、德语、西班牙语、法语、葡萄牙语、意大利语和俄语。
无需登录。

payload.name: Planets360 Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get Vedic astrology calculations from Planets360 using birth date, time and place: Janam Kundli and planetary positions, daily Panchang, planetary transits, Vimshottari Dasa and Bhukti timelines, Chandrashtama dates, Panchapakshi analysis, Moon-sign predictions and compatibility. Editorial explanations cite public Planets360 articles. For informational and spiritual guidance only; not professional medical, legal, financial or safety advice.
payload.longDescription: 通过出生日期、时间和地点获取Planets360的吠陀占星计算：出生星盘和行星位置、每日历法、行星运行、维姆绍塔里分季时间线、月蚀日期、五禽分析、月相预测及匹配度分析。编辑说明引用了公开的Planets360文章。仅用于信息参考和精神指导，不构成专业医疗、法律、财务或安全建议。

payload.name: withPICA Directory
payload.description: 寻找歌曲，直接联系版权所有者。
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Found the perfect song but can't work out who owns it? The withPICA Directory lets you discover and license songs from the people behind them. Every song in it was listed by the people who own it: writers, publishers and labels. So you can see who wrote it, who controls it, and how many credits are confirmed. Search by title, ISRC or ISWC, or by mood, tempo and key for a brief, then send the owner a licensing enquiry in your own words. The owner replies to you directly.

Each result shows the writers and their IPI numbers, publishers, recordings, and how many of its credits have been confirmed by their owners, so you can tell a confirmed credit from an unconfirmed claim.

The directory only sends an enquiry when you ask it to, with your own name, email and project details. Nothing is agreed or priced.

No account or sign-in is needed. The directory grows as more creators list their catalogs, so if something isn't there yet, it says so rather than guessing.
payload.longDescription:
找到完美歌曲却不知谁是版权所有者？
withPICA目录让你直接发现并授权来自歌曲创作者的音乐。
目录中的每首歌曲均由其所有者（如创作者、出版商和唱片公司）主动列出。
你可以查看歌曲创作者、控制方以及已确认的版权数量。
通过歌曲名称、ISRC或ISWC代码，或通过情绪、节奏和调性进行搜索，随后用您自己的语言向创作者发送授权咨询。
创作者会直接回复您的咨询。

每个搜索结果会显示创作者及其IPI编号、出版商、录音信息，以及其版权中已确认和未确认的声明数量，帮助您区分真实版权与未核实的主张。

目录仅在您主动请求时才会发送咨询，包含您自定义的姓名、邮箱和项目信息。
不会有任何协议或定价达成。

无需账户或登录操作。
随着更多创作者主动上传作品目录内容会持续扩展，若当前无法找到所需歌曲，系统会明确说明而非猜测。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Search songs by title, writer or artist, Look up songs by ISRC or ISWC, Search recordings by mood, tempo, key and energy, See writers, publishers, IPIs and which credits are confirmed, Send the owner a licensing enquiry when you ask

payload.name: IRL Sidequests
payload.description: 现实中的支线任务，现在就开启
payload.longDescriptionOriginal: Get a real-life side quest for right now. Tell it how much time you have, whether you want to be indoors or out, and who's with you, and it picks one small, doable adventure from 500+ — a dawn bird-watching patrol, a night photography walk, a neighborhood foraging map, a block-print of your own street — with the steps and the kit it needs. Ask what to look for in any piece of gear and it answers by type (what matters, what to skip, a sensible budget), never by brand. No account needed; everything links back to irlsidequests.com.
payload.longDescription: 立即获取一个现实中的支线任务。输入你可用的时间、是否想待在室内或户外，以及同行人员，它会从500+选项中挑选一个小型可执行冒险——包括清晨观鸟巡逻、夜间摄影散步、社区采集地图、自制街区拓印——并附上所需步骤和装备。询问任何装备的注意事项，它会按类型回答（哪些重要、哪些可跳过、合理预算），而非推荐具体品牌。无需账户即可使用，所有内容均链接至irlsidequests.com。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Pick one side quest for right now, Search 500+ real-life quests, Open a quest's steps, prep and safety notes, Gear advice by type, never by brand

payload.name: Authority Astrology
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Birth chart calculator with complete raw planetary placements, aspects and houses, powered by Swiss Ephemeris. Calculate natal, comparison, transit, progressed, return, relocation and other supported charts. Receive full numerical placements, houses, aspects, timing and calculation provenance. Authority Astrology does not generate summaries, interpretations or scores through this integration. Your chosen LLM can interpret the returned data.

Calculate from supplied inputs without linking an account. Connect an Authority Astrology account to read your saved people and explicitly save or retrieve new raw charts. Older saved chart formats are outside this integration. Birth-time uncertainty remains labelled and large outputs are retrievable in complete pages.

Type your birth or event place in chat. LocationIQ resolves candidate coordinates and timezones; your assistant asks which place you mean when matches are ambiguous. No separate location form or device GPS is needed.
payload.longDescription:
基于瑞士星历表的出生图计算器，提供完整的原始行星位置、相位和宫位信息。可计算出生图、比较图、星盘、推进图、回归图、移居图及其他支持的星图。提供完整的数值位置、宫位、相位、时间及计算来源证明。通过此集成，Authority Astrology 不会生成摘要、解读或评分。您选择的大型语言模型可对返回的数据进行解读。

无需绑定账户即可通过输入数据进行计算。连接Authority Astrology账户可读取已保存的人员信息，并可显式保存或检索新的原始星图。较旧的已保存图表格式不在此集成范围内。出生时间不确定性保持标注状态，大输出可分页完整获取。

在聊天中输入出生或事件地点。LocationIQ会解析候选坐标和时区；当出现多个匹配时，您的助手会询问您具体指哪个地点。无需单独的位置表单或设备GPS。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Calculate complete raw birth charts, Compare charts and retrieve all calculated aspects, Calculate transits, progressions, returns and relocation, Read saved birth profiles and save new raw charts with permission

payload.name: Impostor Party® Games
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Play Impostor, the party word game of bluffing and deduction, with 3 to 20 friends around one device.

Tell ChatGPT how many people are playing and it opens a game card: choose players, impostors, category and language, then pass the device so each player privately sees their role. Civilians get a secret word; the impostor only gets a related clue and has to bluff. Take turns saying one word related to the secret, discuss, and vote to see who the impostor was.

The secret word, the clue and the roles are shown only in the game card, so ChatGPT never reveals them in the conversation. Includes categories such as Food & Drink, Celebrities, Brands and Tech & Internet, plus samples of more categories, in 32 languages. After each game you can play a rematch with a new word or share the result with your friends.
payload.longDescription:
与3至20位朋友围绕一台设备玩《冒名顶替者》这款文字谎言与推理派对游戏。

告诉ChatGPT参与人数，它会打开一张游戏卡：选择玩家、冒名顶替者、类别和语言，然后传递设备，让每位玩家私下查看自己的角色。平民玩家会获得一个秘密单词；冒名顶替者仅获得相关线索并需要进行谎言欺骗。轮流说出与秘密单词相关的单个词汇，进行讨论并投票找出谁是冒名顶替者。

秘密单词、线索和角色仅在游戏卡中显示，因此ChatGPT不会在对话中透露它们。包含饮食、名人、品牌和科技互联网等类别，以及更多类别的示例，支持32种语言。每局游戏结束后可以使用新单词重新比赛，或与朋友分享游戏结果。

information.label: Capabilities
information.value: Deal a secret word and an impostor clue for a pass-and-play Impostor game, Show each player's role privately on one shared device, Run the vote and reveal the result, with rematches, Play in 32 languages, List word categories and explain the rules

payload.name: The Dinner Table Club
payload.description: 与陌生人共进晚餐的聚会
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
The Dinner Table Club hosts dinner parties for strangers at partner restaurants in New York, Washington DC, Los Angeles and Miami, with San Francisco coming soon. Each dinner seats 10 to 20 guests, most of whom come solo, and a host runs the night with seat switches between courses so you meet most of the table.

Ask ChatGPT to find upcoming dinners by city and date. Each result shows the restaurant, neighborhood, local date and time, and whether seats are left, with a link to the dinner's page on thedinnertable.club. You can also ask about one dinner's menu, and get answers about coming alone, the age range, what the ticket includes, dietary needs and bringing a friend.

payload.name: Keyshift Chord Transposer
payload.description: 转换调式与变调夹形状
payload.longDescriptionOriginal:
Keyshift Chord Transposer is an entertainment tool for playing chord sheets on guitar or ukulele. Paste chords above your own lyrics or ChordPro inline brackets, then change the key by semitones, a named key pair or a capo fret. Roots and slash bass notes move while quality text stays in place. Chord starts keep their columns unless longer names collide; later chords then move right with a separating space. Tabs use 8-column stops.

The live monospaced sheet has down and up semitone controls. A capo chart shows frets 0 to 9, the shapes to play and counts of easy open chord names. Transposition includes a printable PDF using a monospaced Courier layout; long lines continue at shared column boundaries and chord/lyric pairs stay together.

Limits: 12,000 characters per sheet, semitone input -11 to +11, capo frets 0 to 9, and capo lists of 1 to 100 chords. Chord names only; no audio, tablature or staff notation. The key estimate uses the first and last chord and can be wrong for songs that change key. PDF text is limited to Western Latin characters supported by Courier; other scripts and unsupported characters are refused before a file is produced. Lyrics are kept in widget-only metadata and an encrypted stateless download link, with no server-side lyric storage.
payload.longDescription:
Keyshift Chord Transposer 是一款用于在吉他或尤克里里上演奏和弦谱的娱乐工具。将和弦粘贴在自己歌词上方或 ChordPro 内联括号中，然后通过半音、指定调式或变调夹品数进行调式转换。根音和斜线低音符会移动，而优质文本保持原位。和弦名称保持原有列位置，除非名称过长导致冲突；后续和弦会向右移动并保留间隔空格。琴谱使用8列制表符定位。

实时等宽乐谱包含上下半音控制按钮。变调夹图表显示0-9品的指法形状及简易开放和弦名称数量。转调功能支持使用等宽 Courier 字体布局的打印PDF；长行会在共享列边界处换行，和弦/歌词组合保持完整。

限制条件：每页最多12,000个字符，半音输入范围-11至+11，变调夹品数0-9，变调夹列表最多包含1至100个和弦。仅支持和弦名称；不包含音频、琴谱或五线谱记号。调式估算基于首尾和弦，歌曲中途转调时可能出错。PDF文本仅限Courier字体支持的西方拉丁字符，其他文字系统及不支持字符会在生成文件前被拒绝。歌词仅以组件专用元数据和加密无服务器存储下载链接形式保留。
